KRISHNADEV S 
SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST | PAYMENTS TRANSFORMATION | OPERATING MODEL & PROCESS 
TRANSFORMATION 
Chennai, India | 9176227990 / 9600166111 | krishnadev85@gmail.com 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Senior Business Analyst with 14+ years of experience across Payments, Banking Operations, Reconciliation and Financial 
Services, with strong experience in payment transformation and operating-model change. Experienced in assessing current-state 
payment operations, identifying process, control and operational gaps, and supporting the design and implementation of target-
state operating-model changes across People, Process and Technology for ISO 20022 and payment-modernization initiatives. 
Strong experience translating AS-IS findings into TO-BE processes, business requirements, process flows, business rules, 
implementation requirements and delivery artefacts. 
Deep domain expertise in SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, CBPR+, cross-border payments, payment processing, clearing, settlement, 
reconciliation and investigations, with experience working across Business, Operations, Technology, QA, Compliance and client 
stakeholders. Experienced across the change lifecycle from current-state assessment and target-state process definition through 
UAT, implementation support, production sign-off and operational control readiness. 
CORE EXPERTISE 
• Operating Model & Transformation: Target Operating Model (TOM) Design & Implementation Support | People, Process & 
Technology | Current-State / AS-IS Assessment | Future-State / TO-BE Design | Operating Model Gap Assessment 
• Process Transformation: Process Transformation & Re-engineering | Process Architecture / Process Mapping | SOPs | 
Implementation Requirements & Roadmaps | Process Optimisation 
• Payments: Payments Transformation | Payment Modernization | SWIFT MT/MX | ISO 20022 | CBPR+ | Cross-Border 
Payments | Payment Processing, Clearing, Settlement & Reconciliation 
• Payment Lifecycle: Initiation | Validation | Screening | Routing | Clearing | Settlement | Reconciliation | Investigations | 
Exception Management 
• Business Analysis: BRD | FRD | SRS | User Stories | Acceptance Criteria | Business Rules | Functional Specifications | RTM 
• Delivery & Stakeholders: Stakeholder Management across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, QA and Client 
Teams | UAT / SIT | Agile / Scrum | JIRA | Confluence 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Sr. Business Analyst | Aston Carter – Client: Wells Fargo | May 2025 – Dec 2025 
• Supported payments transformation and ISO 20022 migration initiatives across domestic and cross-border payment flows,

• Conducted AS-IS vs. TO-BE gap analysis for payment processes, translating identified gaps into business requirements, 
business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria and implementation requirements. 
• Analysed end-to-end payment journeys and process touchpoints across domestic and cross-border payment flows, 
identifying gaps and operational impacts associated with ISO 20022 migration. 
• Supported the design and implementation of target operating-model changes across People, Process and Technology for 
ISO 20022 migration, working with Business, Technology and Operations stakeholders. 
• Analysed payment-process and operating-model impacts associated with SWIFT MT-to-ISO 20022 MX migration, including
